articles.title: TSMC and Taiwan researchers engineered an interface only 0.42 nanometers thick to improve next-generation MoS2 transistors
articles.description: Researchers from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and TSMC have developed a new interface design for atomically thin transistors. The design helped the transistors maintain strong electrical control and carrier transport while using an extremely thin insulating layer.

On This Day in Space: NASA launched the 100-foot Echo 1A balloon on August 12, 1960; the passive satellite reflected telephone, radio and television signals across Earth
articles.description: On August 12, 1960, NASA launched Echo 1A, a 100-foot balloon that became its first successful communications satellite. The passive spacecraft reflected telephone, radio and television signals between distant points on Earth. It also helped NASA study atmospheric density, solar pressure and satellite triangulation before re-entering Earth’s atmosphere in 1968.
